text: My manager asked for this. Could you make Scene2 a bit bigger? Next, make the same one a bit smaller! How many connections are there?
Hmm, let me think. Tidy things up a bit. Set Proxy's color to lime.

Is there a loop? Push every dot below Modem.

Could you reset the diamonds that are not magenta, and wipe the most recent ellipse? Also arrange Temple, Shrine and Tower in a grid. Thanks!
Any hexagons? Spread the triangles out in a column!

I'm drawing the family tree for grandma. Put a cyan triangle right side of Lan. Then send the aqua triangle to the back!
What's the closest shape to Halted? Stars should be indigo from now on. Which shapes are indigo? By default, everything is large.

Kill Bug42, then undo 3 times. Also, inscribe "Done!" on each brown oval!
Turn the brown ones small. Next, rename the amber triangle as Cobalt. Park Check on the left of Verify.
Line up Gateway and Ap2 horizontal, and then join the rectangle to Ap2. After that, shove the orange box left by 20 units.
Can I get from Sensor to R1? Swap Vcc with Ground. What does the last magenta triangle say?

Drop the defaults. Then duplicate Db 6 times.
Hmm, let me think. Attach Climax and Scene1, and erase the connector from Scene1 to Villain. Change fuchsia hexagons to medium.

Make all the navy ones a ball, and then clone the oval.
What does the latest rhombus connect to? Label the oldest circle 'x > 0'. Next, turn it blue.

Ok so I'm sketching our office network. Label the aqua square "upload"! It was getting crowded. How many neighbors has Db got? Scoot Billing in the centre. New diamonds will be silver. That's the main flow. Line up the white ellipses vertical!
Are Db and Worker linked? Morph the squares into a star, and then arrange them in a circle.
Which things are in the upper right? Is Tower white?
Put a star over Swamp, and place Castle to the top left. Thanks!
What is joined to Api? What is downstream from the newest rhombus?

Link Krill to Algae with a line. Does Fish connect to the gray triangle? Bring all blue stars in front.
Turn triangles into a massive blue dot! That's the main flow. Which shapes can be reached from Card? Move the ball to the right by 50 pixels, and organize everything as a row.
Layout all of the green hexagons in a row. After that, sketch me a little scarlet ellipse labelled "beta".
Ditch all the items that are not white, then make the golden star much bigger.
Exchange Footer and the yellow triangle. Connect Sidebar to Toolbar, and Toolbar to Modal.
What is the number of elements? Set the size of all shapes which are not red to medium. Lay out the hexagons as a grid.
What colour is the Card? What color is that one? Rename it to Fable.
Dupe the new teal star twice. Change the color of the white ones to orange! What shapes are rose? List everything between Finish and Reject. Stick twelve golden blocks.
Are any diamonds near Bridge? List the connections of the rectangle. Also pop a triangle right of Volcano!
Zap all shapes! Right, that's better. What is the furthest indigo square from Pod2? Change the amber square to a triangle.

Park all hexagons at the right. Ugh, messy. Shift them 250 pixels downwards! Are any purple stars between Ingress and Billing? Nudge the new lime hexagon between Api and Cache. Kafka is a rect. Perfect.
My manager asked for this. Paint everything green. Is Menu attached to Sidebar? Sever Header from Toolbar.
How many edges do we have? Connect Kelp to Coral, Heron and Seal! Thanks!
Join Validate to Train, and Train to Enrich. Reposition all the turquoise balls above Enrich. What is the color of the circle? Drag the Archive on the left side.
Move running above Waiting, and bring it to the front!
Who has the least connections? In the future, everything is gold.
Insert a big hexagon left side of the lilac hexagon. That way it is easier to read. Link the new one to Queue, and do that again. Describe the diagram? Insert a plain arrow from Cache to Ingress.
Show me the rules? Show all rects in the bottom left. Give all blocks which are not red the colour green.
What's the leftmost one? Erase the oval.
Make Start, Verify and Stop2 tiny. That way it is easier to read. Scale the navy ovals. Then wire Submit, Finish and Start one after other. After that, reshape stars into a square. Thanks!
We are planning the next sprint. Drag Parse, Validate and Train 20px to the left. Also, set the shape of the indigo hexagon to ellipse. Almost done. Is the new box at the bottom edge?
Hmm, let me think. Show me the orange ellipses. Reposition Climax and Intro on top of Ending. Is Scene3 smaller than Scene1?

Ok so I'm sketching our office network. Align Alice, Aunt and Grandpa horizontally. Then draw a white two way connector from Dad to Uncle.

Grow the squares. Color them green!

Tuck Studio right. Hook this one to Hallway, then shift Bathroom in the bottom right.
This is for tomorrow's review. Attach the latest square to Pod2 with a dotted arrow. What's connected to the first ball? Colour triangles crimson. Thanks.
How many edges do we have? Scale all of the fuchsia ovals. Henceforth, new shapes should be rose.

Let me see. Tie Striker to Pivot, Winger and Rb with a dash arrow. After that, send all the white boxes backward! From now on, diamonds are magenta. That way it is easier to read. Spread Tackle and Qb evenly horizontal. That way it is easier to read. What text is on the first circle?
I'm drawing the family tree for grandma. Bring Reject forward, and attach Draft, Decide and Start one after the other! Almost done.
This is for tomorrow's review. Reapply that. That's the main flow. Forget every rule, then reset the defaults, and after that snip Retailer from Plant. Thanks.
Relocate all the triangles underneath the dot, and align them vertically. Add 10 squares along the bottom. Ugh, messy. Set the size of all silver objects to little. Join Plankton and Seal to Fish!
How many amber stars below Users? How many hexagons are to the lower-right? Distribute Team, Goals and Budget evenly in a row.
Space Neptune and Cell horizontal evenly. Is Atom connected to Nucleus? Sketch a block! What color is the new one? Grow this one!
